restoration_note: This teaching describes the Living Spirit's triple discrimination of the natural heavens — extracting corrupt water (mingled truth), darkness (falsity-from-evil), and fire (burning of self-love), clothing himself in pure correspondents (wind/water/fire as perception/truth/love), and binding the corrupt three in encircling strongholds culminating in the Wall of Great Fire — followed by twelve great works of cosmic economy. The body of the text is heavily formulaic (physician analogy, child-in-womb with seven garments → eight teachings, twelvefold enumeration), which strongly constrained many medium-sized restorations through parallel structure. Editor's restorations were largely confirmed, especially those completing technical vocabulary (ⲕⲁⲗⲗⲁⲍⲏ 'womb', ⲙⲁⲛⲝⲗⲟⲣⲉ 'stronghold', ⲡⲍⲟⲩⲟ 'abundance', ordinal series ⲧⲙⲁⲍ-, ⲥⲧⲉⲣⲉⲱⲙⲁ 'firmaments'). Where the lacunae fall in the catalogue of the twelve works (works 2-5, 7, 9, 11) the page is too damaged for reconstruction without inventing content; honest non-restoration was preferred. Final pages with multiple short fragmentary lines (sections 2533-2535, 2542-2548, 2552, 2562-2569) were marked unrestorable.
